key.name: toggle-drawer
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut to show or hide the drawer

key.name: next-site
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut to open the next site in the drawer's top-bar order (opens the drawer if it is folded)

key.name: previous-site
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut to open the previous site in the drawer's top-bar order

key.name: pinned-apps
key.summary: Desktop ids of apps pinned to the drawer: each opens in the drawer's small floating window from its own top-bar icon

key.name: position
key.summary: Where the drawer drops down: under the site's top-bar icon, top centre, or the top-left or top-right corner

key.name: width
key.summary: Width of the drawer, in percent of the screen, until it is resized

key.name: height
key.summary: Height of the drawer, in percent of the screen below the top bar, until it is resized

key.name: size
key.summary: The drawer's size in pixels after the user resized it, the same for every site; (0, 0) uses the percents above

key.name: bar-max
key.summary: How many site icons the top bar shows; the rest are in its ⌄ menu

key.name: open-on-hover
key.summary: Open a site by resting the pointer on its top-bar icon

key.name: hover-delay-ms
key.summary: How long the pointer rests (without moving) on an icon before its site opens, in milliseconds

key.name: hover-switch-ms
key.summary: With a site open, how long the pointer rests on another icon before that site takes its place, in milliseconds

key.name: hide-on-focus-loss
key.summary: Hide the drawer when another window gets focus (a click outside it)

key.name: host-command
key.summary: The drawer app, started on first use if it isn't running
